name: Daniel Johnson
original_name: ダニエル・ジョンソン
source:
Star Sign: Leo
Nationality: American (Half Indian)
Job: Policeman
Special Skill: Cooking, Sewing, Exercise

He's a helpful and reliable person who can't seem to refuse a request.
He has a great physique and exceptional reflexes.
In order to make up for an accident he caused, he joined the team to earn money for his coworkers surgery.
